sql: SELECT clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS measured_at_utc, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT movement_adjusted_sk) AS distinct_movement_keys, min(movement_date) AS first_movement_date, max(movement_date) AS latest_movement_date, count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01') AS october_row_count, round(sum(brl_amount) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01'), 2) AS october_signed_brl_sum FROM public.rpt_inflow__movement_adjusted;
